title: feat(onboarding): Add Enterprise Onboarding Lifecycle Intelligence Hub
body:
## Summary

Adds a full-featured Employee Onboarding Lifecycle Intelligence dashboard to PaySphere.

### 5 Production Files (984 lines)

1. `onboardingService.ts` (221 lines) — Types, seed data, CSV export, color helpers
2. `OnboardingPipeline.tsx` (90 lines) — Kanban pipeline showing hires across onboarding stages
3. `OnboardingFunnel.tsx` (69 lines) — Conversion funnel with drop-off indicators
4. `HireDetailModal.tsx` (146 lines) — Full hire profile with milestones, risk factors, NPS
5. `EnterpriseOnboardingLifecyclePage.tsx` (458 lines) — Main dashboard with 5 tabs, 6 KPIs

### Features
- **Pipeline** — Kanban view of all new hires by onboarding stage with risk indicators
- **Funnel** — Pre-board to completion conversion rates with drop-off analysis
- **Milestones** — 8 key milestones with target vs actual completion tracking
- **Departments** — Time-to-productivity, completion rate, NPS by department
- **Buddy Program** — Buddy effectiveness metrics with satisfaction scores

### Route
`/enterprise/onboarding-lifecycle`
